extracted.intended_audience: casual digital artists and general users of the DrawIsland web drawing tool
extracted.subtask_description: Using the DrawIsland browser-based drawing application to create, save, export, and share digital drawings. Covers canvas sizing, tool settings, project storage, export formats, and gallery metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reset zoom before drawing
rubrics_metrics.description: ⚠️ Click here to reset zoom to 100% before drawing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The UI explicitly warns to reset zoom to 100% before drawing; doing so helps ensure strokes and object placements correspond to actual canvas coordinates and expected export dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select all objects to move or resize them
rubrics_metrics.description: 💡 Don't forget to select all objects to move or resize them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use selection to move/transform multiple objects together; failing to select all objects may leave elements in incorrect positions or scales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local storage project limit
rubrics_metrics.description: My Projects — Local storage · max 5 projects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The app stores up to five projects in local storage. To preserve more work, export projects (.json) or save to gallery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project export/import (.json)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use JSON export/import to back up, transfer, or restore projects between browsers/devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Export formats and export-size choice
rubrics_metrics.description: Download formats: PNG, JPG, PDF. Export size options: Full canvas size or Current view (with zoom).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose 'Full canvas size' to export the entire canvas at its set dimensions; choose 'Current view (with zoom)' to export what is visible at the current zoom level. Select file format according to use (PNG/JPG for raster, PDF for vector/print).

rubrics_metrics.name: Canvas size presets and custom sizing
rubrics_metrics.description: Canvas size controls with presets: Max, Square, Portrait, Custom… (example shown: 800 × 520 px).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set canvas dimensions before composing if you need a specific output size. Custom sizes are supported; canvas size affects export resolution and layout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save to gallery metadata limits & remix permission
rubrics_metrics.description: Save to Gallery fields: Title 0/100, Description 0/300, Tags 0/50; option: Allow others to remix this drawing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gallery submissions have character limits for title, description, and tags. You can permit others to remix your drawing via the provided toggle when saving to the gallery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image library injection API
rubrics_metrics.description: Image Library: No images yet. Inject via window.diImgLib(images).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adding images to the library requires calling the window.diImgLib(images) JavaScript hook; there is no built-in file-upload UI visible on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Toolset availability (pencil, brush, eraser, fill, text, shapes, arrow)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools shown: Pencil, Eraser, Brush, Fill, Text, Rect, Circle, Arrow, Shapes…, Symmetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the variety of tools to draw shapes, text, and filled areas. 'Shapes…' and 'Symmetry' provide assisted drawing modes; choose appropriate tool for the task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool settings: size and opacity controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Controls for tools include Size and Opacity (examples: Size 4, Opacity 100% for Pencil; Brushes Opacity 90%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust Size and Opacity per tool to control stroke thickness and transparency. Presets are available and can be switched during editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Text fonts and typography options
rubrics_metrics.description: Text font options listed: Arial, Georgia, Impact, Courier, Verdana, Comic, Times; Size control present (example size 32).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose from available fonts and set text size to match design; font choices are limited to the listed options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Object properties and manipulation (flip, clone, delete, stroke, shadow, opacity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Object panel actions: Delete, Clone, Flip H, Flip V, Object Opacity, Stroke, Shadow, Sh X/Y.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use object controls to edit individual elements — clone to duplicate, flip to mirror, adjust stroke/shadow/opacity for visual effects, and delete when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Layers and object stacking
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Layer management is available in the UI for ordering objects; use layers to organize complex drawings (specific layer controls not detailed on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: History controls: undo and redo
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Undo/Redo to revert or reapply recent actions during the drawing session; these are the primary recovery mechanisms for mistakes.
